issues.description: The problem statement (both in the UML and textual description) indicates that Milkable.messageOnMilk() should return a boolean (true/false) when milking is successful (UML: messageOnMilk():boolean; text: return true if milking was successful), but the provided solution defines Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return a String and the concrete classes (Seal, Goat) implement it returning String messages (e.g. "Seal <name> is milked"). This mismatch between the expected boolean return type in the problem specification and the String return type in the solution/template will confuse students about the correct method signature and what to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the specification and code. Either (A) change the problem statement and UML to specify that messageOnMilk() returns a String (descriptive message), which matches the template/solution and Main usage, or (B) change the interface and implementations in the template/solution to return boolean and adjust usages/tests accordingly. Option A is recommended since the Main and song printing expect textual messages.
